summary: Master emergency liquidity, collateral frameworks, and crisis management for central banks. Expert-led 5-day course for financial stability professionals.
lede: Central bank crisis operations training explains how monetary authorities respond to severe financial stress and support financial stability. It is for monetary policy analysts, financial stability staff, reserve managers and payment systems supervisors who plan interventions and keep liquidity and settlement operations functioning, with practice in assessing emergency liquidity and collateral, managing real-time gross settlement (RTGS) liquidity, and coordinating crisis measures.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is essential for professionals tasked with maintaining the operational integrity of the financial system during periods of high uncertainty.
modules: Foundations of Central Bank Crisis Operations
Emergency Liquidity Assistance and LOLR Protocols
Unconventional Monetary Policy and Market Interventions
Digital Risks and Modern Bank Runs
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in central banking, financial regulation, or treasury operations. A foundational understanding of monetary policy instruments and basic financial accounting is required. Familiarity with the Basel III framework is highly recommended.
